title: Trump to give Republicans a 3-1 FCC majority, isn't filling empty Democratic seat
summary: Since the FCC needs only three members for a quorum, adding a third Republican raises the possibility that Trump will fire the FCC’s only Democrat and give his party a 3-0 advantage.
